name: chat-recovery
title: 出字后兜底：中断或拒答 → 擦掉重写
description: 出字后识别中断（我方卡顿规则+流内异常）与拒答（运营词池，只判定不压输出），擦掉已显示内容后由兜底模型重写；供应商拒绝/过滤且涉及未成年人不重写
creator: claude

pages: /chat/[characterId]: streaming reply (reset clears the reply being written)

measurement.source: Page load unaffected (no frontend change). For the SSE turn: existing roleplay first-token telemetry (client_first_token_visible_ms) and backend generation.execute duration, split by Android/iOS and provider+model; new stream_end and recovery events.
measurement.window: 24 hours before vs 24 hours after enabling each switch; report N per cohort, insufficient samples stay unverified.

mobile_performance.notes: Page load unaffected: the only frontend change is handling one new SSE event (reset) in the existing stream client and turn hook; 2500ms page targets are the existing chat page ceiling, not new claims. API target 5000ms is the existing first-token deadline for the SSE turn and is unchanged: output is never held (refusal detection only inspects text already being streamed). Recovered turns add stall time (3s) plus fallback first token (<=3s) to total reply duration. Baselines null: no samples for the new recovery paths. Post-release: compare first-token P95 and total duration by platform and Android/iOS with switches on vs off.

scope: Chat SSE generation after first token (consumeStream)
SSE reset event and active delivery buffer reset
chat_recovery_config managed config read and Admin editor
integration_points: platform/observability/fetch.ts clientFetch for the fallback call (existing generation.transport)
failure_paths: Stall watchdog fires on a slow but healthy stream: rewrite proceeds by design, recorded as stalled with max_gap_ms
Fallback HTTP error, no first content within fallback_first_token_ms, or under 20s left to execution deadline: no reset, settle as interrupted with what the user sees, no charge
Fallback stalls after reset: settle as interrupted with the rewrite text shown, no charge
Provider refusal or content_filter involving minors: skipped (minor_guard), original delivered or interrupted unchanged
User stop, output cap, execution deadline during recovery: abort fallback, existing terminal handling
Old clients ignore reset: transient concatenation, corrected by persisted content after done
Config missing or invalid: both switches off, warn once per version
Ledger write failure or migration not yet applied: warn only, conversation unaffected
logging_integration.correlation: Reuse request ALS request_id/trace_id plus history_id and attempt/call ids already used by generation and call-ledger; fallback call shares the turn's business context.
logging_integration.redaction: Only counts, durations, enums, provider/model ids and http status. Never log reply text, refusal text, matched keyword text, user input or prompt; keyword pool is config, not logged.
logging_integration.alerting: No new alert rules. Existing generation failure alerts unchanged; recovery outcome rate is reviewed via SQL on ops.llm_calls after enabling.
verification: Regression tests assert events/outcomes for success, fallback failure, timeout, refusal discard, minor skip, user stop
Development environment real turn: inspect Railway Pino JSON for the three events with allowlisted fields only
